response.content:

My first question didn't get your answer back, so I guessed and searched for a contact called "Avery Example". You never gave me that name. The search results were also blocked every time, so I couldn't even see who matched.

When I asked again, the only reply I got was "Yes".

To go ahead, please reply with:
1. **The contact**: their exact email or phone number works best, since I can look them up directly that way.
2. **The tag**: the exact wording, for example "VIP".

I'll tell you which contact I find before I add the tag.
